text.offer: Far'Nohl himself haunts his throne room, mad and powerful beyond anything else in that castle. He comes back, again and again, to take his revenge on trespassers. Destroy him - and bring friends, as many as you can.
text.progress: The ghost of Far'Nohl haunts the throne room of Castle Victoria, beyond the antechamber.
text.complete: The mad king, destroyed - for a while, at least. Castle Victoria has not been this quiet in an age.
